task_description: Record-aware MAINFRAME editor SAVE: RC.B.8 Part 2 (b)-(d) wiring plus BRC.4 (the mainframe Command Environment in ff-idcams), built together as one end-to-end slice. The mainframe CE implements ff-vfs::BackendEnvironment over ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess (resolve/allocate -> open -> put -> close; x37 -> non-zero rc); the registry gains a named-backend map + backend_for; the save seam resolves the backend by the active tab's owning_environment; mainframe tabs bind owning_env=MAINFRAME + a real DSN identity + the dataset RECFM at open and the nav edit-gate is lifted; the live catalog-scheme VFS provider is registered. Edits land directly on main, uncommitted, for the owner's full gate. ASCII-only .rs; 400-non-test-line rule; build ON the framework (single save seam, single open command, no second dispatcher).
